series.subject: CSEC Mathematics
series.goal: At least Grade II in CSEC Mathematics, May-June 2027, aiming for Grade I

episodes.title: Meet Arjun
episodes.summary: Meet Arjun Ramdeen, a Form 5 student and leg-spinner from Penal, south Trinidad. He scored 38% in Form 4 maths and says he is "not a maths person". In his first session we set his goal, look at the whole exam, and run a diagnostic test.

lessons.title: Number Sets, Factors, HCF and LCM
lessons.why: Sets up the next session, The Diagnosis and the Plan (Thu 26 Nov 2026).

lessons.title: Fractions, Decimals and Percentages
lessons.why: Sets up the next session, The Diagnosis and the Plan (Thu 26 Nov 2026).

homework: Watch Lesson 1: Number Sets, Factors, HCF and LCM, and Lesson 2: Fractions, Decimals and Percentages. Phone in another room.
Do item 5 again: 3/4 + 2/5, every step written down. Bring it on Thursday.

episodes.title: The Diagnosis and the Plan
episodes.summary: Arjun gets his diagnostic results: 15 out of 30. We find his five weaknesses, with evidence from his own work, and build a 23-week plan around the cricket season.

lessons.title: Algebra Basics and Directed Numbers
lessons.why: For algebra: Directed numbers first: say each sign aloud and use the number line.

homework: Watch Lesson 16: Algebra Basics and Directed Numbers.
Write five sums with negative numbers from real life: temperatures, money, or net run rate. Bring them on Sunday.
Ten minutes of algebra on the bus to Couva.

episodes.title: Algebra Nets: Signs and Brackets
episodes.summary: Algebra nets. Arjun's sign errors and bracket errors come from half-remembered rules. We fix directed numbers with his team's net run rate, then expand brackets with an arrow to every term.

lessons.title: Expanding, Factorising and Binary Operations
lessons.why: For algebra: Directed numbers first: say each sign aloud and use the number line.

homework: Nets on Monday, Wednesday and Friday: 10 expansions and 5 directed-number sums each time. Photograph the page and send it.
Do the three your-turn questions again tomorrow, without looking at these answers.
